snc.text: New Capenna was founded when archangels struck a deal with archdemons against a Phyrexian ship that was poisoning the plane, but the demons then trapped the angels during a victory celebration and converted them into Halo.
The story picks up as Elspeth arrives wondering whether the city is the home Ajani promised, and the Maestro boss Xander recruits her as a spy.
Seers across the city share one vision, and Kamiz traces it to Lagrella, who reveals that the Cabaretti have figured out how to make Halo.

On the night of the Crescendo, Ob Nixilis, the hidden Adversary, strikes the leadership of all the families, killing Xander and mortally wounding Jetmir, and Giada's sacrifice awakens the city's angels.
